cues.title: 笼子排除了哪一种解释？
cues.titleEn: Which explanation does the cage exclude?
cues.caption: 挡住直接研磨，仍允许胃液进入。
cues.captionEn: Block direct grinding; let gastric fluid through.
cues.zh: 肉块被金属笼保护，胃壁不能直接研磨它，胃液却能进入。笼子里的肉仍然消失了。这个对照排除了直接研磨是唯一原因，却没有认出胃液中的具体物质。下一步应把胃液分离出来，比较它与单独盐酸的作用。
cues.en: The cage protects one piece of meat from direct grinding, while gastric fluid can enter. The meat still disappears. This rules out grinding as the only cause, but does not identify the active substance. The next test separates gastric fluid and compares its action with acid alone.

cues.title: 加热和加酶，差别在哪里？
cues.titleEn: How do heating and catalysis differ?
cues.caption: 升温改变能量条件；催化改变反应路径。
cues.captionEn: Heating changes energy conditions; catalysis changes the pathway.
cues.zh: 四管从相同的过氧化氢开始，冒泡的快慢却不同。先看加热：原来的反应路径没变，分子获得能量，更容易越过能垒。再看催化：温度保持不变，催化体系提供另一条能垒较低的路径，本身在反应后恢复。它不是给反应补充燃料。回到试管，酶让氧气更快出现，却不会凭空增加过氧化氢能生成的氧气总量。若先把酶严重加热损伤，再在相同温度检测，你预测这条捷径还在吗？
cues.en: The tubes begin with equal peroxide, yet release bubbles at different rates. Heating keeps the original pathway but makes higher-energy states more accessible. Now hold temperature fixed. A catalyst provides another pathway with a lower barrier and is regenerated after turnover. It is not fuel for the reaction. Back in the tubes, oxygen appears sooner, but catalysis cannot create extra oxygen beyond the starting peroxide. If severe heating damages the enzyme before a matched-temperature assay, will that catalytic pathway remain available?

cues.title: 没有完整细胞，反应还会继续吗？
cues.titleEn: Can the reaction continue without intact cells?
cues.caption: 完整细胞不是这段反应必需的存在形式。
cues.captionEn: This reaction does not require intact cells.
cues.zh: 酵母经研磨、压榨和过滤，完整细胞留在滤渣，汁液中仍有溶出的成分。给汁液加糖，仍然形成酒精和二氧化碳。完整活细胞不是这段反应必需的存在形式。不过，滤液仍是复杂混合物，这还没有证明某一种纯酶的身份。
cues.en: Grinding, pressing and filtering yeast separates intact cells from dissolved material. Add sugar to the extract, and ethanol and carbon dioxide still form. This reaction does not require intact living cells to remain present. The extract is nevertheless a mixture; the experiment has not identified one purified enzyme.

cues.title: 结晶怎样同时连接成分与功能？
cues.titleEn: How do crystals link composition and function?
cues.caption: 蛋白性质和催化活性，需要两条证据。
cues.captionEn: Protein properties and catalytic activity require distinct evidence.
cues.zh: 把同一批脲酶结晶溶解，再分成两份。一份检验蛋白质性质，另一份检验它能否催化尿素分解。两条证据回答的是不同问题：有蛋白质，不等于已经证明催化；有催化，也不等于知道成分。萨姆纳把这些证据结合起来，确认了这份脲酶的蛋白质性质。
cues.en: Dissolve one batch of urease crystals and divide it into two samples. One tests protein properties; the other tests urea breakdown. These answer different questions. Protein does not by itself prove catalysis, and catalysis does not identify composition. Sumner combined such evidence to establish the protein nature of this urease.

cues.title: 同一种酶，为什么结果不同？
cues.titleEn: Why does the same enzyme give different outcomes?
cues.caption: 能结合并形成反应构型，才能走催化路径。
cues.captionEn: Productive binding needs the right chemical arrangement.
cues.zh: 同一种淀粉酶作用后，淀粉组出现还原性产物，蔗糖组却没有相同变化。把一小段淀粉放大：连续的葡萄糖单元在多个接触点定位，使要断开的连接靠近催化部位。水参与水解，链变短，酶还能继续工作。蔗糖的连接方式不同，不能形成这里所需的反应构型。专一性不是按颜色挑选，也不只是外形像钥匙。换一种能催化蔗糖水解的酶，结果就可能改变。
cues.en: After the same amylase treatment, starch yields reducing products while sucrose does not show the same change. Zoom into a short starch segment. Several contacts position its glucose units and bring the target linkage into a productive catalytic arrangement. Water participates in hydrolysis, shorter fragments leave, and the enzyme can work again. Sucrose has a different linkage and does not form this arrangement. Specificity is chemical as well as geometric. A different enzyme that hydrolyzes sucrose can change that outcome.

cues.title: 两支都慢的试管，原因一样吗？
cues.titleEn: Can two slow samples have different causes?
cues.caption: 低温减慢过程；强热还可能损伤催化结构。
cues.captionEn: Cold slows turnover; severe heat can damage catalytic structure.
cues.zh: 先看等时反应后留下的淀粉。低温组反应慢，强热组也可能留下很多，但原因未必相同。低温下，酶的结构仍能保持，只是反应过程较慢。强热还会逐渐破坏维持催化部位的结构，原来的接触关系不再合适。温度同时影响反应速度和结构保存，不能只记一个最高点。把各组都恢复到同一温度，再比较一次，能分开这两种解释。
cues.en: Equal-time samples can leave much starch after either cold or severe heat, but the causes need not match. In the cold, catalytic structure may remain intact while turnover slows. Severe heat can also progressively disrupt the arrangement that supports catalysis. Temperature affects both reaction speed and structural survival. A peak is specific to the enzyme and assay. Bringing all samples to one temperature gives a new test of the two explanations.

cues.title: 酸碱改变了酶的什么？
cues.titleEn: What does pH change in an enzyme?
cues.caption: 酸碱改变基团状态；极端条件还可能破坏结构。
cues.captionEn: pH changes group states; extremes may also damage structure.
cues.zh: 相同温度下改变酸碱，先与每种酸碱条件下的无酶空白比较，再判断酶带来的放氧。再看一个解释模型：酸碱会改变某些基团带不带氢、带什么电荷，影响催化所需的接触和反应状态。极端条件还可能破坏空间结构。所以活性降低不只有一种原因。恢复原来的酸碱条件后，活性是否回来，是下一条证据，不能只看原来那支冒泡少的试管。
cues.en: At a matched temperature, compare oxygen release across pH conditions with a no-enzyme blank for each. Now switch to an explanatory model. pH changes the protonation and charge of some chemical groups, altering contacts and reaction states needed for catalysis. Extreme conditions can also damage the fold. Reduced activity therefore has more than one possible cause. Restoring the original pH provides a further test; low bubbling alone cannot tell us which cause occurred.

cues.title: 回到相同条件，能恢复吗？
cues.titleEn: What recovers under the same conditions?
cues.caption: 统一检测条件，才能读出处理留下的影响。
cues.captionEn: A common assay condition reveals the effect of pretreatment.
cues.zh: 这次只先处理酶，之后三组都回到二十五摄氏度，再加入相同的新底物。低温组的催化结构还在，反应恢复；严重受热损伤的那一组仍然较慢。现在温度相同，差别来自之前留下的状态。这解释了为什么许多酶制品要低温保存，而不是使用前越烫越好。这里演示的是未恢复的热损伤，不代表所有酶在所有条件下都不能重新折叠。
cues.en: Pretreat the enzyme first. Then bring all three samples to twenty-five degrees and add equal fresh substrate. The cold sample retains its catalytic structure and recovers activity; the severely damaged sample remains slower. With the current temperature matched, the difference reflects prior history. This helps explain cold storage of many enzyme preparations. The model assumes persistent heat damage; it does not claim that every enzyme is unable to refold.

translations.有效成分缺失，模型中不形成发酵产物: Without active material, the model produces no fermentation products
translations.模型中未形成发酵产物: No fermentation products in this model
translations.两条路径起点终点相同，催化路径能垒较低: The paths share endpoints, with a lower catalytic barrier
translations.同一条肽链逐渐失去催化构型，肽链本身没有被剪断: The same peptide trace loses its catalytic arrangement without being cut
translations.多个接触点定位葡萄糖链，水参与一处α1,4键的净水解: Several contacts position glucan; water participates in net alpha-1,4 hydrolysis
translations.完整细胞被分离，含催化成分的汁液仍可形成发酵产物: Cell-free extract retains components that produce fermentation products
translations.损伤后，催化路径还可用吗？: Can the damaged enzyme still catalyze?
translations.时间与温度共同决定模型中的保存状态: Time and temperature determine survival in this model
translations.极端条件还可能损伤结构: Extremes may also damage the fold
translations.此模型的有效组合: The competent pair in this model
translations.每种酸碱条件都有自己的空白: A matched blank at each pH
translations.汁液是混合物，并非一种纯酶: The extract is a mixture, not one pure enzyme
translations.示意预处理；不是通用保存配方: Illustrative treatment, not a storage recipe
translations.笼子阻挡直接研磨而允许胃液进入，肉块仍逐渐减少: The cage blocks direct grinding but admits gastric fluid; the meat decreases
translations.等时取样；碘液显示长淀粉链: Equal-time samples; iodine reveals long glucan chains
translations.蔗糖具有葡萄糖和果糖的不同连接，不能利用同一催化构型: The glucose–fructose linkage does not form the same productive arrangement

translations.高能状态尾部放大；升温增加同一门槛以上的权重: An enlarged high-energy tail shows increased weight above the same barrier with heating

question.zh: 加热和加酶都能让反应变快，为什么细胞更需要酶？
question.en: Heating and enzymes both speed reactions—why do cells rely on enzymes?

description.zh: 从对照现象追到能垒、催化构型与状态历史，再用恢复条件作预测。
description.en: Follow controlled observations to barriers, catalytic arrangements and state history, then predict recovery.

question.zh: 金属笼如何区分机械研磨与化学消化？
question.en: What does the cage distinguish about digestion?

principle.zh: 屏障选择性排除一种作用，剩余现象支持另一类解释，但不自动确定具体成分。
principle.en: A selective barrier excludes one action while retaining another; the result does not automatically identify the active chemical.

transferQuestion.zh: 如果只把肉放入盐酸，结果足以认定胃液的全部作用吗？
transferQuestion.en: Does meat in acid alone establish all the action of gastric fluid?

transferAnswer.zh: 不足。需与含胃液成分、且其他条件匹配的组比较；P76施旺结果支持除盐酸外的催化成分。
transferAnswer.en: No. A matched comparison with gastric components is still needed; the textbook follows with evidence beyond acid alone.

curriculum.windowDecision: Preserve existing window; each chapter must carry its own observed evidence→explanation→prediction.

question.zh: 同样冒泡，加热与加酶为什么不是同一种办法？
question.en: Why are heating and catalysis different ways to make bubbles faster?

principle.zh: 升温改变热能条件；催化提供较低能垒路径，在温和条件下提高速率而不增加固定底物的理论产量。
principle.en: Heating changes thermal conditions; catalysis provides a lower-barrier pathway without increasing the theoretical product from fixed substrate.

transferQuestion.zh: 酶更多，最终能凭空多生成氧气吗？
transferQuestion.en: Can adding more enzyme create extra oxygen from the same peroxide?

transferAnswer.zh: 相同底物完全转化的理论氧气总量不变，达到终点更快；真实未完全反应或失活会影响实际回收量。
transferAnswer.en: It can speed the approach to completion, not increase the stoichiometric endpoint. Actual incomplete conversion or enzyme damage can affect recovered product.

curriculum.windowDecision: Preserve existing window; each chapter must carry its own observed evidence→explanation→prediction.

question.zh: 离开完整细胞，发酵为什么还能继续？
question.en: Why can fermentation continue without intact cells?

principle.zh: 可分离的催化体系保留了反应能力；完整细胞在这一试管反应中不必持续存在。
principle.en: Separated catalytic components retain activity, so intact cells need not remain present for this reaction.

transferQuestion.zh: 滤液会发酵，能证明其中只有一种纯酶吗？
transferQuestion.en: Does active filtrate prove there is just one purified enzyme?

transferAnswer.zh: 不能，仍是多组分混合物。
transferAnswer.en: No. The extract is still a mixture.

curriculum.windowDecision: Preserve existing window; each chapter must carry its own observed evidence→explanation→prediction.

question.zh: 一份结晶，需要哪两类证据才能判断它是什么？
question.en: What two kinds of evidence identify an enzyme crystal?

principle.zh: 催化活性与化学性质是互补证据，互不能代替。
principle.en: Chemical properties and catalytic activity answer complementary questions.

transferQuestion.zh: 蛋白质检测阳性就足以说明它是脲酶吗？
transferQuestion.en: Is a positive protein test sufficient to identify urease?

transferAnswer.zh: 不足，还需特定催化活性及纯度/分离相关证据。
transferAnswer.en: No. Specific catalytic activity and evidence relating it to the purified material are also needed.

curriculum.windowDecision: Preserve existing window; each chapter must carry its own observed evidence→explanation→prediction.

question.zh: 同样的酶，为什么两个可水解底物结果不同？
question.en: Why does one enzyme give different results with two hydrolysable substrates?

principle.zh: 生产性结合依赖连接方式、局部化学基团与动态构型，只有合适底物能有效利用该催化路径。
principle.en: Productive binding depends on linkage chemistry, local chemical groups and a suitable dynamic arrangement.

transferQuestion.zh: 给蔗糖换成能水解它的酶，检测结果会怎样？
transferQuestion.en: What if sucrose is treated with an enzyme that hydrolyzes it?

transferAnswer.zh: 在适宜条件和有效阳性/空白对照下，预期水解后产生可检测的还原性糖。
transferAnswer.en: With suitable conditions and controls, reducing products are expected after hydrolysis.

curriculum.windowDecision: Preserve existing window; each chapter must carry its own observed evidence→explanation→prediction.

question.zh: 活性低，是当下条件不合适，还是已经留下损伤？
question.en: Is low activity a present-condition effect or persistent damage?

principle.zh: 温度和酸碱影响反应条件与酶状态；统一恢复条件并使用新底物可区分可逆影响和持续损伤。
principle.en: Temperature and pH affect both immediate reaction conditions and enzyme state; a common-condition assay with fresh substrate separates these explanations.

transferQuestion.zh: 低温与强热组都变慢，回到同一温度后一定相同吗？
transferQuestion.en: Must cold and strongly heated samples behave alike after returning to one temperature?

transferAnswer.zh: 不一定，低温下保留结构的一组可恢复；受损组取决于损伤及是否能复性。
transferAnswer.en: No. A preserved cold sample can recover while a damaged sample depends on the injury and its capacity to refold.

curriculum.windowDecision: Preserve existing window; each chapter must carry its own observed evidence→explanation→prediction.

storyboard.question: 笼子里的肉消失了，究竟排除了什么？
storyboard.caption: 挡住直接研磨，仍允许胃液进入。
storyboard.captionEn: Block direct grinding; let gastric fluid through.
beats: Track one meat piece behind a rigid cage. External compression visibly reaches bars, not the meat.
Follow a fluid parcel through cage openings; the same meat piece loses material gradually. No enzyme-specific identity assigned to the fluid.
Hold cage/meat endpoint beside two causal candidates: direct grinding alone fails; chemical action remains compatible. Predict a separated gastric-fluid test.
limits: Historical reconstruction from textbook P76; no invitation to repeat animal experiment. Fluid transport and shrinking are explanatory, not measured digestion dynamics.

storyboard.question: 加热和加酶都能冒泡，细胞为什么更需要酶？
storyboard.caption: 升温改变能量条件；催化改变反应路径。
storyboard.captionEn: Heating changes energy conditions; catalysis changes the pathway.
beats: Four equal-volume tubes: room blank,90°C bath,FeCl3,liver extract. Rate-derived oxygen bubbles at matched time; show native qualitative observation before any energy figure.
Zoom to matched reaction-coordinate profiles. Heat keeps the uncatalyzed pathway; a broader thermal-energy distribution makes crossing more likely. Track one labeled H2O2 pair in net-reaction inset.

Keep temperature/distribution unchanged and overlay a lower catalytic pathway. Same initial/final energies, lower maximum. Enzyme/catalyst returns to its initial state after one turnover. No food-like energy packet enters from the enzyme.
Return to four tubes with accumulated product curves: different early slopes, equal theoretical endpoint for complete conversion. Separate measured-looking observations from teaching curves.

Predict boiling the enzyme before adding fresh peroxide: energy of assay is equal, but the alternative pathway is lost when catalytic structure is damaged. Lead into later recovery without assuming this one test identifies all liver chemistry.
limits: Energy profiles are qualitative reaction-coordinate explanations, not actual measured H2O2 energy surfaces. The molecular-energy distribution is a stated teaching approximation, not an exact solution-phase reaction criterion.

Specific Fe3+/catalase efficiency ordering is this textbook comparison, not all enzyme/inorganic catalyst pairs. Catalysts do exchange energy during intermediate steps; no net fuel supply is the intended claim.
Use net2H2O2→2H2O+O2 ledger; do not depict it as an elementary concerted2-molecule pathway or imply the illustrated atom mapping establishes the catalytic mechanism.

storyboard.question: 酵母细胞被分开后，为什么还会发酵？
storyboard.caption: 完整细胞不是这段反应必需的存在形式。
storyboard.captionEn: This reaction does not require intact cells.
beats: Track same marked yeast batch through grinding/pressing/filtration. Cells and large debris remain in residue; dissolved components pass.
Add glucose to the filtrate. CO2 bubbles and independent ethanol identification appear; matched inactive-extract counterfactual remains quiet.

Contrast intact-cell-only hypothesis with extract result. Keep multiple differently shaped dissolved catalysts, not a single purified enzyme. Predict losing activity when catalytic components are damaged.
limits: Historical conclusion retained. Filtration is a conceptual separation; show fragmented cells and dissolved material, not claim ordinary paper alone renders every preparation cell-free.

storyboard.question: 看到结晶就能说它是酶吗？
storyboard.caption: 蛋白性质和催化活性，需要两条证据。
storyboard.captionEn: Protein properties and catalytic activity require distinct evidence.
beats: Same crystal batch dissolves into one stock, then two aliquots preserve sample identity.
Protein-property branch gives a representative positive assay; activity branch depletes urea and forms ammonia-containing products. No gratuitous gas bubbles.
Two evidence paths reunite at the candidate identity. Protein assay alone does not prove catalysis, activity alone does not prove protein composition; RNA exception retained in article.
limits: Protein assay is a representative reconstruction, not claimed exact1926 procedure. Aqueous ammonia/carbonate speciation depends on pH; do not render NH3 and CO2 as necessarily escaping bubbles. Not all enzymes are proteins.

storyboard.question: 淀粉和蔗糖都能水解，为什么同一种酶只改变其中一组？
storyboard.caption: 能结合并形成反应构型，才能走催化路径。
storyboard.captionEn: Productive binding needs the right chemical arrangement.
beats: Matched starch/sucrose samples with same amylase. Equal later Fehling assay reveals positive starch hydrolysate versus unchanged sucrose; no assay flame during the enzyme action stage.

Bring a marked alpha1,4-linked glucan segment into a flexible multi-contact binding groove. Carbon/ring/bridge identities visible; glycosidic oxygen aligns with catalytic acid/base region, neighboring contacts stabilize orientation.

Show net water addition and cleavage of an internal alpha1,4 bond; fragments leave, enzyme reused. Newly accessible reducing ends link back to separate copper assay. Do not promise all products are glucose.

Use the same groove with sucrose glucose-fructose1↔2 linkage: spatial and chemical contacts do not form the modeled productive configuration. No magical rejection by color or only a keyhole silhouette.
Prediction: a different enzyme such as sucrase can support another pathway; sucrose was not chemically impossible to hydrolyze. Distinguish process evidence from molecular model.
limits: Textbook material identity is unspecified; use a qualified alpha-amylase mechanism illustration, not claim its exact enzyme is human pancreatic1CPU.

Starch has reducing ends but is operationally negative in this classroom assay; avoid absolute claim that no starch molecule has a reducing end. Products are shorter saccharides/reducing ends, not only glucose.
Do not infer a molecule never binds at all from lack of catalysis. No fixed incorrect alpha1,4 linkage on sucrose.

storyboard.question: 冰水和热水都可能让颜色留下，原因相同吗？
storyboard.caption: 低温减慢过程；强热还可能损伤催化结构。
storyboard.captionEn: Cold slows turnover; severe heat can damage catalytic structure.
beats: Three equal-time starch/amylase samples after separate matched-temperature iodine testing. Low/mid/high treatment gives different remaining-starch readouts. Assay readout is clearly after sampling, not a live blue solution reacting.
Same enzyme and substrate identities at cold versus moderate temperature. Lower thermal rate but preserved contact geometry; small movements never freeze completely at5°C.

High-temperature pretreatment accumulates damage with time. A preserved chain connectivity opens/distorts; catalytic contacts no longer align. No peptide backbone cleavage or protein melting into featureless blobs.
Overlay turnover-versus-surviving-structure contributions, then predict a recovery test at one common temperature. Peak belongs to this example and assay duration, not universal enzyme temperature.
limits: Independent thermal rate and exposure-dependent inactivation; not a universal temperature Gaussian. The same current temperature with different histories can give different activity.
Iodine colors depend on glucan chain length and assay conditions; use qualitative remnant-chain indicator, not a universal linear concentration colorimeter.

storyboard.question: 酸碱只改变试管颜色，还是改变了酶的工作条件？
storyboard.caption: 酸碱改变基团状态；极端条件还可能破坏结构。
storyboard.captionEn: pH changes group states; extremes may also damage structure.
beats: Catalase oxygen rates at matched temperature/enzyme/peroxide. Each pH has no-enzyme blank, so direct reagent/peroxide effect is separated from catalytic contribution.

Switch explicitly to generic ionizable-group explanatory model: bound H identity transfers between solution reservoir and a carboxyl group; local charge and compatible contact change without tearing the full protein.
Severe-pH branch weakens supporting contacts and alters folded geometry; two cause layers kept separate. This is not a fitted liver-catalase active-site animation.
Predict restoration experiment: common pH and fresh substrate may restore a reversible ionization effect; persistent loss points to additional damage. Do not guarantee recovery or an optimum7.
limits: Generic ionization/structure explanation, not exact liver-catalase residues or kinetic pKa. A bacterial catalase-peroxidase study is supporting existence evidence only.

Raw oxygen rate minus blank is a controlled-comparison concept; only subtract under matched independent background assumptions, otherwise display side-by-side controls without claiming corrected enzyme kinetics.

storyboard.question: 都回到相同温度，为什么有一组仍慢？
storyboard.caption: 统一检测条件，才能读出处理留下的影响。
storyboard.captionEn: A common assay condition reveals the effect of pretreatment.
beats: Track three labeled enzyme samples during cold/reference/severe-heat pretreatment; no substrate consumption yet. Preserve exposure history in strip.

Move all samples into equal25°C assay, add identical fresh substrate simultaneously. Current temperature and substrate ledger equal; cold/native contacts recover fast turnover, damaged sample retains misalignment.
Show paired initial slopes and active-fraction/structural states. Different outcomes at sameT exclude merely current-temperature explanation.
Transfer prediction: cold storage can preserve susceptible enzyme activity; reheating is not a general repair. Other enzymes and treatments may renature, so name the model damage assumption.
limits: Restoration is a distinct test, not simply running longer in the original temperatures. Fresh equal substrate avoids earlier depletion masquerading as activity loss.

modelQualifications: 能量坐标以R*Tref为单位，显示Boltzmann状态尾部示意，不是Maxwell速度分布或实测能垒。
速率、损伤常数、预处理时长和pKa是说明用参数，不拟合特定来源酶。
水解图显示净键变化，省略大多数侧基，保留反应O/H身份，不称原子级逐步机理。
pH基团模型独立于教材肝脏酶观测，不赋予其具体肝脏过氧化氢酶位点或pKa。
脲酶含氨/含碳产物用净物料读数，溶液具体物种随条件变化，不虚构气泡。
pH气泡由同一尺度的瞬时通量驱动，空白和加酶不可分别放大。
探索切换pH重新计算一个新条件场景，不表示受损的同一份样品立即复性。
